question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Guile
solution:
The correct answer is: **Honesty**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Guile"** means the use of clever but usually dishonest methods to achieve something; it involves cunning or deceit. (छल)

 
 
• **Example: **The salesman used all his guile to close the deal, misleading the customer about the product's true capabilities.
 
 

 
• **"Honesty" **refers to the quality of being fair and truthful; the state of being honest. It implies a refusal to lie, steal, or deceive in any way. (ईमानदारी)

 
 
• **Example: **Her honesty earned her the respect and trust of her colleagues, as she always spoke the truth, even when it was difficult.
 
 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Guile' **is **'Honesty'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Honesty**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Deceit **(धोखा): The action or practice of deceiving someone by concealing or misrepresenting the truth.

 
 
• **Example:** The deceit involved in the scheme was eventually uncovered, leading to legal action.
 
 

 
• **Treachery **(विश्वासघात ): Betrayal of trust; deceptive action or nature.

 
 
• **Example: **His treachery was revealed when his plot against the king came to light.
 
 

 
• **Terseness** (संक्षिप्तता): The quality of being brief and to the point; conciseness.

 
 
• **Example:** Her terseness in communication sometimes came off as abrupt or rude, though she was just being efficient.
